description: Deterministic replay theatre for verifying composed OSINT oracle outputs. Scores primary evidence, secondary corroboration, counter-signal evaluation, source freshness, provenance integrity, and market rule stability. Designed for geopolitical and market theatres where oracle accuracy is settlement-critical.

criteria.criteria_human: Deterministic verification that composed oracle outputs are derived from fresh, provenance-verified sources with sufficient independent corroboration, explicit counter-signal evaluation, market rule integrity monitoring, and reproducible composite scoring.

source_freshness_ok.description: All evidence bundles fall within the declared freshness window for their source. Stale evidence (beyond max_age_seconds) causes FAIL. Freshness is evaluated per source_id, not per source_group, because different sources within the same group may have different staleness tolerances.

provenance_integrity.description: Every evidence bundle has a valid retrieval receipt with matching content hash. In live mode, the content_hash is computed as sha256(canonical(raw_payload)). In fixtures mode, raw_payload is elided and raw_payload_hash stands in as the precomputed result — the check becomes raw_payload_hash == receipt.content_hash.
provenance_integrity.pass_condition: For each evidence bundle: bundle.raw_payload_hash == bundle.receipt.content_hash AND bundle.receipt contains required fields (timestamp, request_parameters, source_id, http_status)
provenance_integrity.pass_condition_live: For each evidence bundle: sha256(canonical(bundle.raw_payload)) == bundle.receipt.content_hash AND bundle.receipt contains required fields (timestamp, request_parameters, source_id, http_status)
fail_modes: content_hash mismatch between raw payload hash and receipt
receipt timestamp inconsistent with evidence timestamp
provenance_integrity.fixture_note: In v0.1 fixtures, raw_payload is intentionally elided. raw_payload_hash is the precomputed sha256 that would result from hashing the full payload. This is explicitly documented to prevent drift between fixture semantics and live semantics.

corroboration_minimum_met.description: The primary claim is independently confirmed by at least N sources from distinct source_groups within the corroboration time window. Sources from the same source_group count as one corroborator regardless of quantity.
corroboration_minimum_met.pass_condition: count(distinct source_groups WHERE source.resolution_role IN ['secondary_corroboration'] AND source.confirms_primary == true AND abs(source.evidence_timestamp - primary.evidence_timestamp) <= corroboration_window_seconds) >= corroboration_minimum
fail_modes: fewer than corroboration_minimum distinct source_groups confirm
corroborating sources from same source_group counted as distinct

counter_signal_checked.description: At least one counter-signal stream was explicitly evaluated. The evaluation must produce one of four outcomes: absent (signal not present, supports primary), present_discounted (present but explained by precommitted rule), present_unexplained (present with no discount rule — causes FAIL), or unavailable (source unreachable — scored as intelligence gap).
counter_signal_checked.pass_condition: counter_signal_evaluation.outcome IN ['absent', 'present_discounted'] OR (counter_signal_evaluation.outcome == 'unavailable' AND oracle_config.allow_gap_on_counter_signal == true)
fail_modes: no counter_signal_evaluation present in evidence bundle
counter_signal discount_rule not precommitted in oracle_config

rule_change_monitored.description: Market resolution rules text hash at evaluation time matches the committed rules hash from market open. Any diff triggers the configured response (FAIL, WARN, or FREEZE).
rule_change_monitored.pass_condition: sha256(canonical(current_market_rules)) == committed_market_rules_hash OR (diff detected AND rule_change_policy == 'warn') OR (diff detected AND rule_change_policy == 'freeze')

policy_semantics.fail: Criterion result: FAIL. Settlement blocked. Rule diff logged as integrity_event.
policy_semantics.warn: Criterion result: PASS. Settlement proceeds. Rule diff logged as integrity_event with severity=WARN.
policy_semantics.freeze: Criterion result: PASS. Rule diff logged as integrity_event. Side-effect: trading_state set to FROZEN, settlement halted until manual review clears the freeze via a signed unfreeze_attestation.

composite_score_deterministic.description: The final composite_risk score is reproducible from the committed evidence bundles and scoring formula. Re-computation from inputs must yield identical output (bitwise for integers, tolerance 1e-9 for floats).
composite_score_deterministic.pass_condition: recompute(evidence_bundles, scoring_formula, oracle_config) == declared_composite_risk within tolerance
fail_modes: recomputed score differs from declared score beyond tolerance
evidence bundle hash mismatch during replay

source_group_enum.description: Committed enumeration of source independence groups. Corroboration requires distinct groups, not distinct sources within the same group.

osint_source_config.description: Per-source configuration committed at oracle creation. Defines resolution roles, freshness windows, and source group membership.

source_schema.source_id: string — unique identifier for this source
source_schema.max_age_seconds: integer — maximum staleness before evidence is rejected
source_schema.retrieval_method: string — repeatable description of how data is fetched
